item.title: Fifteen challenges, fourteen flags: BlackHat MEA 2026 CTF qualifiers
item.description: A full technical writeup of all 15 BlackHat MEA 2026 CTF qualifier challenges: an 8-query Prony attack on a secret modulus, an RSA oracle leaking only popcount, a real io_uring double-free driven to root, licence-check shellcode decrypted inside the kernel by eBPF, a CSS selector oracle under a JS-free CSP, and an ffmpeg external-data-reference file read.
